matchup_findings.statement: Arizona holds the early-down edge: its offense stays ahead of the chains on 1st and 2nd down against this defense (+2.58) more than West Virginia does (-1.43).

Arizona's passing offense meets a West Virginia defense it out-rates on the matchup scale (+3.01) (pass success rate, opponent-adjusted: Arizona offense #16 of 138, West Virginia defense #136 of 138).
Arizona's explosive passing offense meets a West Virginia defense that allows explosive pass plays (+2.24).

Arizona owns the stronger opponent-adjusted sustained-efficiency matchup: West Virginia offense vs Arizona defense -0.59, Arizona offense vs West Virginia defense +2.42 (success rate, opponent-adjusted: Arizona offense #15 of 138, West Virginia defense #128 of 138).
Both offenses and both defenses point to more snaps than an average FBS game (possession environment +1.12).
2 independent volatility indicators are present: this matchup has wide outcomes.
West Virginia's offense has swung widely from game to game relative to its opponents (game-to-game residual variation in the 80th percentile of FBS).
West Virginia's yardage leans on explosive plays (share +1.25 SD) more than its down-to-down success rate (+0.18 SD) supports: a less repeatable path.

pace.definition: possession_environment = (z of home offense plays + z of away defense plays allowed + z of away offense plays + z of home defense plays allowed) / 2, on adjusted values. Positive = more snaps than an average FBS game. tempo_environment = -(z of each offense's possession seconds per play) / 2

volatility.definition: offense_ypp_residual_sd = game-to-game spread of the offense's yards per play around what the fit expected against each opponent; its percentile is within the FBS universe. explosive_yard_share_z is the raw share standardised across FBS (not opponent-adjusted). takeaways_per_game_z and giveaways_per_game_z are RAW per-game turnover counts standardised across FBS: turnovers are regression-prone and are deliberately not opponent-adjusted.

adjusted_unavailable_reason: descriptive tendency: opponent adjustment does not apply to this metric (V1)
